dct_description_sm: The purpose of this data collection effort was to characterize the dominant vegetation types and depth of vegetation cover (LAI) in twelve sample plots, at which we were also collecting a variety of other biophysical data. Seasonal change was of interest, thus two rounds of surveys in early and peak growing season were done. Noting vegetation type by functional group was more important than precise identification of species. This is NOT a comprehensive botanical survey of the Cape Bounty area.
